data_description.energy_total: Continuously increasing overall counter. At least one energy counter is required
data_description.energy_session: Counter that resets at the start of each charging session. At least one energy counter is required
data_description.plug_state: Required. Entity with status values of the wallbox's cable connection
data_description.identification: RFID or eMAID reported by the wallbox, if available
data_description.error: Entity indicating an error state of the wallbox
data_description.identification_from_register: Reads the identification directly from the wallbox instead of from an entity, in up to two sequences per charging session: shortly after the session begins and, if that finds nothing, with the first charging. Needs the direct read in the expert options and a device that provides a register for it. Leave the identification entity empty

expert.name: Expert options

data_description.power_threshold_kw: Power above which a charging phase begins. Without a usable plug state, power above it also begins a session
data_description.start_debounce_s: How long the plug state, or the power where the plug state does not report, must hold before the session is confirmed
data_description.identification_window_s: How long to wait after session start before the charging vehicle is identified from the vehicle entities. Relevant when identification via RFID or eMAID is not possible and entity updates arrive with a delay
data_description.direct_read_enabled: Off by default. While off, no connection is made and the address, port and unit ID below are not used
data_description.host: Host name or IP address of the wallbox. Required while the direct read is on

expert.description: Direct read: the wallbox is read over Modbus TCP, read-only, in up to two sequences per charging session: from ten seconds after it begins and with its first charging phase, at most ten reads each, five seconds apart. Modbus TCP is switched off on delivery of the KEBA P40 and has to be enabled in the KEBA eMobility app; reading card identifiers has to be enabled there separately. The connection is not encrypted, use it in a trusted network segment. The wallbox may accept only one Modbus client at a time, and whether a second client is accepted next to an energy management system is not guaranteed. If the wallbox cannot be reached, a repair issue is created. Firmware versions before 1.2.1 report the energy registers at ten times the scale

confirm.description: Must be set to true. The deletion cannot be undone.

role_entity_removed.title: Assigned entity removed
role_entity_removed.description: The entity assigned to the {role} role of "{subentry_title}" was removed from the entity registry. Assign a new entity to this role.

role_unit_changed.title: Unit changed
role_unit_changed.description: The entity assigned to the {role} role of "{subentry_title}" now reports a different unit than when it was assigned. The role is not read until this is resolved. Open the role's dialog and re-select the entity to confirm the new unit.

unknown_mapping_value.title: Unrecognized raw value
unknown_mapping_value.description: The {role} role of "{subentry_title}" reported the raw value "{raw_value}", which the assigned device's mapping does not know. This is resolved by an updated mapping in the integration, not by a manual assignment.

mapping_source_below_min_version.title: Mapping source outdated or missing
mapping_source_below_min_version.description: The source integration for "{device}", chosen for "{subentry_title}", is not installed or older than {integration_name} {min_version}. Data collection continues; update or install the source integration to resolve this.

unknown_card.title: Card not held by a vehicle
unknown_card.description: A charging session at "{wallbox_title}" started with a card that no active vehicle holds. The session is recorded in full and stays unassigned. If the card belongs to a vehicle, add it to that vehicle.

energy_counter_switched.title: Energy counter switched
energy_counter_switched.description: The energy counter previously used at "{wallbox_title}" did not increase during charging while the other one did. The capture now uses {counter}. Check the counter assignment in the wallbox dialog.

direct_read_unreachable.title: Wallbox not readable directly
direct_read_unreachable.description: The card identifier could not be read from "{wallbox_title}": the wallbox gave no valid answer to the Modbus request. Check the address, port and unit ID in the expert options of the wallbox and that Modbus TCP is enabled on the wallbox. The wallbox may accept only one Modbus client at a time. The charging session is recorded in full and is identified by the other means available.

direct_read_invalid_value.title: No card identifier read
direct_read_invalid_value.description: The wallbox "{wallbox_title}" answered, but its register holds no valid card identifier. Reading card identifiers may need to be enabled in the wallbox app, or the charging session was not authorized with a card. The charging session is recorded in full and is identified by the other means available.
